title: Footprints of magnetic particulate matter and black carbon in the Ny-Ålesund area, the Arctic
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00772G, Paper
Yue Lin, Lin Liu, Hang Yang, Yacong Liu, Dawei Lu, Dong Cao, Yingming Li, Jianjie Fu, Ruiqiang Yang, Qinghua Zhang, Qian Liu, Guibin Jiang
Black carbon and MPM are the focus of this study, with their concentration and distribution patterns examined in detail for their correlation with human activities in the Ny-Ålesund area, the Arctic.
